Ram Mandir Donation Probe Leads to Staff Changes, Declining Collections

An SIT investigation into alleged irregularities in donations to the Ram Mandir in Ayodhya has led to the removal of approximately 40 employees involved in counting contributions. The probe has reportedly raised questions about the trust's functioning and transparency. Following these developments, donation amounts have significantly decreased, with one report indicating a 72% drop.
